label: DrayTek VigorAP 962C (VAP962C-K)
description: DrayTek VigorAP 962C - Wi-Fi 6 AX3000 ceiling/wall access point: 2x2 5 GHz up to 2402 Mbps and 2x2 2.4 GHz up to 574 Mbps, with one 2.5GbE RJ45 uplink that takes 802.3at PoE+ in (12 W maximum). Managed over HTTP/HTTPS, Telnet/SSH or TR-069, and able to manage up to 8 mesh VigorAPs.
notes: Powered by 802.3at PoE+ on the uplink or by a DC 12 V 1.5 A supply that is not included, so a lab has to power it from a PoE+ switch or injector - the spec declares `poeIn: 12` W for exactly that reason, and an 802.3af-only PSE is short of the class this AP asks for. One wired port only: the 2.5 Gigabit uplink, which also accepts 1G/100M/10M. Both radios are 2x2 with 1024-QAM, which is where 2402 + 574 Mbps comes from; 256 concurrent clients and 16 SSIDs are management limits the switch model does not police.
